source: TikTok Shop Seller Center (public docs), verified 2026-08-10. Fees evolve frequently - verify before pricing decisions.

baseCommission.note: 6% flat for most US categories; payment processing is included. Jewelry and Pre-Owned categories are 5%.

fbtFulfillment.multiItemNote: Multi-item orders cost less per unit
fbtFulfillment.note: Weight-based single-item FBT rates (Seller Center, verified 2026-08-10). The mandatory FBT rollout was paused in Feb 2026; FBT remains the default, lowest-risk fulfillment option for US sellers.

fbaFuelSurcharge.note: 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge added to FBA fulfillment fees effective Apr 17, 2026.

refundAdminFee.note: 20% of referral fee, capped at $5 per SKU.

creatorCommission.note: Seller-set commission rate paid to TikTok creators/affiliates. ON TOP of the base commission.

fully_managed.label: Fully managed (FBT)
fully_managed.sellerResponsibility: Ship bulk to TikTok consolidation warehouse

disclaimer: TikTok Shop fees change frequently. Weight-based FBT tiers, 6%/5% referral, $0.30 transaction fee, and 1% cross-border fees are consistent with 2026 documentation. Always confirm in TikTok Seller Center.
